headline: Sunstone North Lab jumps from 1,394th to 82nd

sections.text: Sunstone North Lab gained 7.45 to reach 33.59, moving from 1,394th to 82nd on the ARC-AGI-3 public board.
The climb puts the team inside the top 100, with the public gold line at 37.98.
